headline: NTT Data is reportedly in the final stages of talks to build a data center in Osaka for Anthropic that could cost about 1 trillion yen, or $6.3 billion.
score_reason: Big and fresh, but it is an unconfirmed report from unnamed sources and no deal is signed; kept at 7 because the pool headline already says 'report'.
importance_line: Anthropic's first dedicated data center in Japan would add large AI computing capacity in Asia, but it rests on unnamed sources, no deal is signed and supplying 500 megawatts of power is still an open problem.
summary: Nikkei Asia reports, citing several sources, that NTT Data Group, an IT services company, is in late-stage talks with Anthropic over an Osaka data center of about 500 megawatts of power capacity, among Japan's largest, with partial operation possible by 2028; neither company has commented. The reported cost excludes servers and chips, and because supplying that much power from the grid is hard the companies are said to be weighing on-site generation and fuel cells.
notes: Original is Nikkei Asia (only its opening paragraph was readable); details read in W.Media's relay of the Nikkei report. Pool source Data Center Dynamics was blocked (HTTP 403).
